# Chain inputs that are NOT in git (too large, or generated by an earlier chain/collector run). One path per line, relative to the repo root;
# a `# size, producer` comment follows each. A line ending in `/` is a directory (a glob such as `outputs/press_refresh_*/` is allowed):
# `chain_parity.py freeze --list` copies every file under each match and fails when nothing matches, as it does for a missing file.
# Small hash-bound inputs ARE tracked (see .gitignore "chain inputs") and are not repeated here.
# Obtain these from the machine that holds the live tree (OneDrive copy of Melange Systems); none can be rebuilt from a bare clone.
